text: あなたは　いそいで　どこへ　ゆくの？

patterns.name: 〜て (how)
patterns.explanation: The て-form here tells in what way the next action is done. いそいで = 'hurrying', 'in a hurry'.

patterns.name: 〜の (question)
patterns.explanation: の at the end with a rising voice makes a soft, casual question. どこへ　ゆくの？ = 'where are you going?'.
